name: How do I know if my ice maker water line needs repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my ice maker water line needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs your ice maker water line needs repair include visible water puddles behind or under your refrigerator, reduced ice production, or a sudden increase in your water bill. You might also notice a strange smell if mold or mildew has started to grow due to a slow leak. A simple check homeowners can perform is to visually inspect the line for kinks, drips, or discoloration, particularly where it connects to the wall and the appliance, before calling for service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for water puddles, reduced ice production, a higher water bill, or a strange smell, and visually inspect the line for kinks or drips.
